g.title: Skill procedures (MOD-012)
Published procedure sources
Interpret RR, reuse or refine existing IR/SR and supporting Features/Scenarios, and propose new requirements only for distinct needs.
Independently assess the exact requirement basis, including justified reuse; establish the first mandatory approval.
Define logical Functions and behavior against accepted SRs, preserving Feature intent and requirement ownership.
Define responsible Modules, Interfaces, realization and derived ARs; use the architecture views to examine the design.
Assess System and Architecture Design together against the accepted requirement basis in one integrated review.
Define implementation milestones, dependencies, proof and recovery from accepted requirements and reviewed design.
Assess sequencing and proof allocation, including one whole-change review before final Verify.
Implement authorized work with relevant checks; continue across milestones when conditions permit and hand off the complete scope for review.
Provide optional interim advice or the mandatory independent whole-change review; reassess corrections within the same gate.
Assess the final completion claim using current evidence and applicable whole-change approval; return defects to their owner.
Coordinate authorized activities, blockers and correction ownership without creating engineering approval.
Establish or revise the project purpose, intended outcomes, and product direction.
Establish or revise the project's governing engineering principles.
Build or refresh an observed repository orientation map with source and uncertainty boundaries.
Compare materially distinct directions for an unsettled engineering problem.
Resolve a bounded factual uncertainty with attributable evidence and an explicit conclusion.
Diagnose or correct a bounded defect against its governing behavior and reproducible evidence.
Review or revise repository automation for coverage, execution, permissions, and maintenance needs.
Prepare or perform an explicitly authorized pull-request handoff from the current verified subject.
Capture supported reusable lessons and route derivative work to its accountable owner.
